mapper.insert: INSERT INTO room (room_code, host_id, room_title) VALUES (#{roomCode}, #{hostId}, #{roomTitle})
mapper.update: UPDATE room SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE room_id = #{roomId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM room_participant WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT r.room_id, r.room_code, r.host_id, r.room_title, r.created_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM room_message m WHERE m.room_id = r.room_id AND m.message_id > COALESCE(p.last_read_message_id, 0) AND (m.user_id IS NULL OR m.user_id <> #{userId})) AS unread_count FROM room_participant p JOIN room r ON r.room_id = p.room_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY p.joined_at, r.room_id
SELECT u.user_id, u.login_id, u.nickname, u.profile_image FROM room_participant p JOIN users u ON u.user_id = p.user_id WHERE p.room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY p.joined_at, u.user_id

SELECT s.schedule_id, s.user_id AS owner_id, u.user_id AS participant_id, u.nickname, s.title, s.start_time, s.end_time, s.is_secret, s.status FROM room_participant p JOIN users u ON u.user_id = p.user_id JOIN schedule s ON s.status <> 'CANCELED' AND s.show_in_compare = 1 AND s.start_time < #{to} AND s.end_time > #{from} AND ( s.user_id = p.user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM schedule_member m WHERE m.schedule_id = s.schedule_id AND m.user_id = p.user_id AND m.status = 'ACCEPTED') ) WHERE p.room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY s.start_time, s.schedule_id, p.joined_at
SELECT user_id FROM room_participant WHERE room_id = #{roomId}
